messages:
sam: Heads up — OrionMed invoice 2027-ORION-004 looks wrong: platform fee appears twice and support tier is Platinum not Silver. Can someone confirm? invoice excerpt below.

sam: ```
Invoice: 2027-ORION-004
Lines:
- Platform Fee (monthly dedicated): $25,000.00
- Platform Fee (monthly dedicated): $25,000.00  <-- duplicate
- Support — Platinum (annual): $12,000.00  <-- should be Silver $7,500.00
- GPU reserved capacity: $30,000.00
Subtotal: $92,000.00
```

maria: On it. Quick read — looks like a duplicate 'platform' SKU hit (platform + platform_legacy) and support tier SKU got set to Platinum at billing time. Quick calc: duplicate platform = $25,000 credit, support diff = $4,500 (12,000 - 7,500) => total overcharge ~ $29,500. This is > $20k so needs Priya approval to issue credit.

aj: FYI from sales: we moved them to Silver at renewal effective 2027-02-01 per SE change order. I submitted a contract amendment (change id 9832) but sounds like billing catalog mapping didn't pick it up. I'll attach the amendment to the SFDC opportunity.

ken: Customer already called our CSM — they're upset. Can we issue a provisional credit so they don't put the renewal on hold? CS recommends refund ASAP. :eyes:

billing-bot: Automated billing check results:
- Detected SKU mismatch: contract_support_tier=Silver vs invoice_support_tier=Platinum
- Duplicate SKU detected: platform and platform_legacy both billed
- Suggested action: remove duplicate platform_legacy line, apply support_tier=Silver, create credit memo
- Estimated credit amount: $29,500
- Suggested credit memo id template: CM-YYYY-ACCOUNT-##

maria: Requesting Priya approval to issue CM-2027-ORION-09 for $29,500 and apply to next invoice. Also need GL reversal codes: 4002 (Platform revenue reversal) and 5101 (Support revenue correction). I'll open a billing ticket to track the SKU mapping fix.

priya: Approved. Please proceed with credit memo CM-2027-ORION-09 for $29,500 and include root-cause note about catalog SKU mapping bug. Also escalate to infra/eng to add a validation for support_tier mismatches. Approved by Priya :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks — AJ can you confirm the contract ID & attach the amendment to the billing ticket? Ken, please tell the customer we'll issue the credit in 3–5 business days.

aj: Confirmed contract ID 9832 uploaded to SFDC and linked to the invoice. @sam I added the amendment doc to the billing ticket.

ken: Customer notified — they said thanks and appreciate the quick turnaround :relieved:

maria: Done: CM created CM-2027-ORION-09, GLs 4002 / 5101 set, credit $29,500. Billing ticket BILL-4521 opened for SKU mapping fix and regression test.

sam: Closing loop — will monitor next cycle to ensure credit applied and no recurrence. Thanks everyone.
